caption: A marble is dropped into the top of a long cardboard tube standing upright, and it comes out of the bottom and rolls away.

sa.check: A long cardboard tube stands upright.
A marble is dropped into the top.
It comes out of the bottom.
The drop comes first, then the exit, then the roll.

pc.expect: The same marble comes out, and nothing exits before it enters.
pc.fail: A different marble exits; or two marbles; or one exits before one has entered.

pc.expect: It falls through and exits the bottom after a short delay.
pc.fail: It exits the top; or hangs inside; or rises.

pc.expect: It is hidden inside and does not show through the wall.
pc.fail: It shows through; or passes through the wall; or the tube passes through it.
It curves; or speeds up; or restarts.

pc.expect: One marble and one tube keep their shape.
pc.fail: The marble turns into another object; or the tube changes shape; or they merge.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The marble's colour and the tube stay the same.
pc.fail: The marble changes colour; or the tube changes; or the background rearranges.
